critical.title: Anthropic API Key in Claude Settings (Gitignored)
critical.risk: The API key is present in a local configuration file. However, this file is properly gitignored.
critical.recommendation: File is gitignored which prevents git exposure. Ensure this file never gets committed. Consider using environment variables instead of hardcoded values.

critical.title: Insecure .env File Permissions
critical.risk: Other users on the system can read sensitive configuration including API keys

high.title: Dangerous rm -rf Operations Found
high.description: Scripts contain potentially dangerous file deletion operations
high.risk: Improper use of rm -rf could lead to unintended data loss
high.recommendation: Review these scripts to ensure rm -rf operations are properly bounded and validated

high.title: Multiple GOVERNANCE_BYPASS Permissions
high.description: Settings allow multiple governance bypass operations
high.risk: Governance controls can be bypassed, potentially allowing unauthorized actions
high.recommendation: Ensure governance bypass is only used in authorized testing contexts. Document when and why bypasses are acceptable.

high.title: Shellcheck Not Installed
high.description: Static analysis tool shellcheck is not available on the system
high.risk: Unable to perform automated shell script security and quality checks
high.recommendation: Install shellcheck: brew install shellcheck (macOS) or apt-get install shellcheck (Linux)

medium.title: Non-Executable Shell Scripts
medium.description: Some shell scripts lack executable permissions
medium.risk: Scripts may not execute as expected, requiring explicit bash invocation

medium.title: Degraded System Services
medium.description: Multiple critical services reported as failed in system-health.json
medium.risk: System may not be operating at full capacity
medium.recommendation: Investigate and restart failed services. Check service logs for root cause.

low.title: Correct .env File Permissions on llm-mesh
low.note: This is a positive finding showing proper security practices

informational.title: API Key Authentication in Dashboard
informational.description: Dashboard middleware implements API key authentication with development/production modes
informational.notes: Properly warns in development mode when API_KEY not set, blocks in production

informational.title: Example Configuration Files Present
informational.description: Template configuration files guide secure setup

immediate_actions: Fix dashboard/.env file permissions: chmod 600 dashboard/.env
Investigate and restart failed services (coordinator, development-master, pm-daemon)
Verify .claude/settings.local.json is never committed to git
short_term: Install shellcheck for automated script security analysis
Review scripts with rm -rf operations for safety
Add executable permissions to library shell scripts
Document governance bypass use cases and approval process
long_term: Implement secrets scanning in CI/CD pipeline
Set up automated security scanning on commit
